components: Coincidence of binary suffix distributions bounds pairwise preparation overlaps even under an input-independent shared classical seed. Noisy boxes can exclude a proposed dimension; a real qubit example reaches equality and a multi-output countercontrol blocks generalization.
candidates.declared_status: Exact finite controls for a necessary dimension inequality; no empirical interval coverage or quantum reconstruction inferred.
missing_bridges: Bind unconditional binary outcomes, common input-independent mixing, and simultaneous statistical coverage to the tested apparatus.

components: A declared random choice on every trial permits inverse-propensity estimates of one common time-averaged response. Simultaneous rational time-uniform intervals protect against setting imbalance and drift under explicit independence requirements.
candidates.declared_status: Conditional inference design with a synthetic false-exclusion control; unknown propensity schedules cannot be recovered from grouped counts.
missing_bridges: Establish recorded assignment probabilities, all trials and no current-setting leakage in actual data.

components: Independently replay one preselected preparation and measurement processor job from a hash-pinned public count file. The published witness is reproduced; a dimension cut is evaluated only with explicit extra stationarity and sampling premises.

missing_bridges: The archive lacks shot-level randomization and isolation evidence; test a prospective all-attempt randomized design.
